featured_reviews.name: latika shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot recommend Poonam highly enough for her exceptional makeup skills! She has a true gift for bringing out each person’s natural beauty while adding that flawless, professional touch. Whether it’s a soft, elegant look or full glam, Poonam knows exactly how to tailor the makeup to suit the occasion and the individual.

Her attention to detail, calming presence, and passion for her craft make the entire experience enjoyable and stress-free. She doesn’t just apply makeup—she creates magic.

Equally impressive is her incredible team of hairdressers. They have a talent for turning every customer’s vision into reality. From intricate updos to sleek, modern styles, they listen carefully and deliver beyond expectations every single time.

Together, Poonam and her team are a dream to work with. Their professionalism, creativity, and warmth make every appointment feel special. If you’re looking for a makeup artist and hair team that truly care about making you look and feel your best, look no further!

featured_reviews.name: Dee Kam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was absolutely thrilled with the incredible work done by Poonam for my wedding reception! She was warm, professional, and genuinely invested in bringing my vision to life.

On the day of the event, she arrived right on time and immediately put me at ease with her friendly demeanor. She took the time to understand my style and preferences, and her expertise truly shone through as she crafted my look. The makeup was really well done – it enhanced my features beautifully without feeling heavy or overdone, and I felt like the best version of myself. The hair was equally lovely; it held all night and complemented my outfit perfectly.

What impressed me most was her attention to detail and commitment to ensuring I was happy every step of the way. I received countless compliments from friends and family, and I felt radiant in every photograph.

If you're looking for a talented, professional, and truly passionate makeup artist, I cannot recommend Poonam highly enough. She helped make my reception day unforgettable, and I am so grateful for her artistry and kindness! Thank you so much for making me feel beautiful on such a special day!

featured_reviews.name: leena musale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Neeta did an exceptional job with my bridal makeup and all the wedding functions. She made me feel truly special, confident, and at my best on my big day, creating a magical, flawless, and beautifully natural look.

I have very sensitive skin and was quite worried and nervous about makeup products and possible side effects; however, thanks to Neeta’s expertise and use of top-notch products, I did not experience even a single breakout or reaction on my skin. Her expert techniques enhanced my features and elevated the entire look without making the makeup appear heavy or layered.

Even my father, who is completely against makeup, as well as family members who generally prefer very minimal makeup, were extremely impressed by the natural and graceful look she created. The makeup looked fresh and perfect throughout each event.

Neeta and her team were highly professional, skilled, and punctual, ensuring everything ran smoothly. Thank you, Neeta, for your incredible work and for making my wedding experience so special. I truly appreciate the professionalism and talent of the entire team and would highly recommend Neeta to any bride seeking a refined, natural, and stunning bridal look.

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Suvarna
featured_reviews.review_text:
TL;DR — Neeta is a magician. Book her before someone else does! 😄

When I say she’s the best, I don’t just mean at makeup (which she absolutely aces) — she’s also an amazing listener, super calm, and gives suggestions you can trust with your eyes closed.

I first met Neeta during my makeup trial. After being traumatised by previous makeup experiences and considering I have zero makeup knowledge, I dragged a friend along for support. She was running late, but within five minutes of meeting Neeta, I actually told her not to come. That’s how instantly comfortable Neeta made me feel. She actually listened to what I wanted!

Fast forward to the wedding day: literally everyone told me I looked beautiful; but the best part was that I felt beautiful. And the ultimate test? My dad, who hates makeup, loved the look - which says everything. That’s the magic Neeta brings.

And her team is as calm and nice as she is! They do an incredible job!

So don’t think twice. Book her. Your future self will thank you :)
